title: Escaping Offline Pessimism: Vector-Field Reward Shaping for Safe Frontier Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2603.18326v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While offline reinforcement learning provides reliable policies for real-world deployment, its inherent pessimism severely restricts an agent's ability to explore and collect novel data online. Drawing inspiration from safe reinforcement learning, exploring near the boundary of regions well covered by the offline dataset and reliably modeled by the simulator allows an agent to take manageable risks--venturing into informative but moderate-uncertainty states while remaining close enough to familiar regions for safe recovery. However, naively rewarding this boundary-seeking behavior can lead to a degenerate parking behavior, where the agent simply stops once it reaches the frontier. To solve this, we propose a novel vector-field reward shaping paradigm designed to induce continuous, safe boundary exploration for non-adaptive deployed policies. translated_title: 逃离离线悲观主义：用于安全边界探索的向量场奖励塑形
translated_abstract: 虽然离线强化学习为现实世界部署提供了可靠的策略，但其固有的悲观主义严重限制了智能体在线探索和收集新数据的能力。受安全强化学习的启发，在离线数据集覆盖良好且模拟器能够可靠建模的区域边界附近进行探索，使智能体能够承担可管理的风险——进入信息丰富但不确定性适中的状态，同时保持足够接近熟悉区域以便安全恢复。然而，简单地奖励这种寻求边界的行为会导致一种退化的“停车”行为，即智能体一旦到达边界就会停止不动。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的向量场奖励塑形范式，旨在为非自适应的部署策略诱导持续、安全的边界探索。该奖励基于从离线数据训练的不确定性预测器，结合了两个互补的组成部分……
tldr: 该论文提出一种向量场奖励塑形范式，通过引导部署策略在离线数据覆盖区域的边界进行持续且安全的探索，克服离线强化学习的悲观主义限制，同时避免智能体到达边界后停止不动的退化“停车”行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a vector-field reward shaping paradigm that induces continuous, safe exploration at the boundary of well-covered offline data regions, overcoming the pessimism of offline reinforcement learning while avoiding degenerate parking behavior.
